about_the_game:
After a party, you help your new friend Banjo discover events that took place last night on a drunken fun get-together!

In a short-story adventure where your choices change which different events you'll see from the previous night's party, partake in various raunchy scenes, discover how much of a Bad Dog, this Good Boy can be.

After discovering somewhere along the way he's lost his car keys, he asks if you've seen them and if you'd help him recall events that took place so maybe he can locate them.

All the while, you might have to make him beg for them and have a little after party moment as well.

Through dialogue choices you can discover what happened last night with the character, or just get dirty again in the morning.

With a sizeable gallery of artwork and fun roleplay-esque scenarios you'll have plenty of good time with this after-party party-animal.

Drunken, alcohol furry parties, watersports and fun experiences of enjoying friends' company in an environment that embraces sexual freedom and friends being intimate in a consensual environment, you can expect a different flavor from vanilla.

Make dialogue and click-pointer choices to get to the multiple enticing endings in this small recollection, piece together the slots of this memory puzzle and discover scenes that will have you wanting to collect achievements and perhaps enjoy the view.

First game to the Bad Dog series.
